title: An intelligent prompt system for product generative design based on style perception preference values
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: This study proposes an intelligent prompt system for product generative design based on style perception preference values. The system collects and analyzes design prompts, constructs a mapping model between design elements and style perception, and integrates it with a diffusion model to generate designs. The system is validated through experiments comparing its performance with traditional methods.
